title: 火灾机制难以应对
description: 火灾无法有效应对，即使立即响应也会导致永久性伤害，甚至使游戏无法进行。
evidence: everyone who was in the room now has chronic emphysema from smoke inhalation
Unfortunately the fire mechanics added to the game have made it utterly unplayable.
